set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/model. Acceptance: replace orthogonal FitEngine plus broad FitConfig with a FitStrategy ADT that carries only legal config; add ModelError and Either smart constructors; dimension-check plan-dependent censored timepoints, weights, and nuisance matrices at FitPlan construction; type AR, robust, LSS, nuisance, formula, and column identities; add model-owned validated design block. Verification: modelJVM/test and modelJS/test plus fit compile fallout.
set.title: Type inspectable model plans and legal fit strategies
